title: Go-to-market synchronization and release-notes workflow for customer rollouts
creator: Asha Gupta
description: Objective: Create an end-to-end operational playbook and templated workflow for coordinating release notes, customer-facing comms, and cross-team launch activities for customer rollouts (private + hosted + dedicated). This ticket covers: 1) a canonical release-notes process (authoring, review, localization, and publishing cadence), 2) a GTM sync checklist across Eng/SRE/Product/Design/Support/Sales/CS, 3) lighthouse account engagement plan and feedback channels, and 4) success criteria and telemetry dashboards for first 30 days post-rollout. Deliverables: a Confluence playbook, final release-notes template, Slack/Email cadence templates, sign-off gate definition, and an automated dashboard spec for monitoring. Rationale: multiple recent launches showed inconsistent release-note quality, delayed comms to customers, and missing early signal dashboards — this creates a repeatable, low-friction path to align teams and reduce time-to-feedback for beta and lighthouse customers.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published and linked from product wiki
Release-notes template available in Drive with tags for audience, breaking changes, migration steps, and example snippets
Cross-team GTM checklist completed and assigned owners for each step

Sign-off process defined: Product + Eng + SRE + Compliance + CS approvals recorded in ticket before public publish
At least one pilot customer (lighthouse) scheduled for soft-run with supporting CS and success criteria validated
